verdict.rationale: Data export is a fair question for a SaaS work-management tool, so the axis applies, but the evidence pack never documents an export feature or any open export format. The only data-portability item is 'Import data into Trello', which is the opposite direction. The REST API is a developer building block, not an export capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
